resources.string: Root-free auto tapper for Fire tablets
Lets SpringCat AutoClicker perform automatic taps at a point you choose. No content is read from the screen.

1. Tap the button above and turn "SpringCat AutoClicker" ON in Accessibility.
2. Return here — a floating panel and a blue target appear on screen.
3. Drag the blue target to where you want the taps.
4. Set the interval with − / +.
5. Press START. Press STOP to end.

The target passes taps straight through while running, so it never blocks the app underneath.

This app uses no Google Play Services, so it runs on Fire OS 6, 7 and 8. To install the APK, enable \"Apps from Unknown Sources\" (Settings ▸ Security & Privacy) for your file manager or browser, then open the APK. If the floating controls do not appear, re-toggle the accessibility service OFF and ON.
